containerDefinitions.name: nginx-proxy
command: echo 'server { listen 80; location /api/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9001/api/; } location /customers/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9001/customers/; } location /consents/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9002/consents/; } location /gst/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9003/gst/; } location /aa/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9004/aa/; } location /fhc/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9005/fhc/; } location /credit/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9006/credit/; } location /cam/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9007/cam/; } location /ocen/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9008/ocen/; } location /ckyc/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9011/ckyc/; } location /mca/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9012/mca/; } location /epfo/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9013/epfo/; } location /rbi/ { proxy_pass http://localhost:9014/rbi/; } location /livez { proxy_pass http://localhost:9001/livez; } }' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf && nginx -g "daemon off;"
